# Delta Air Lines declares quarterly dividend


Staff Writer


Sep 24, 2026 4:30pm


Delta Air Lines' (NYSE:DAL) Board of Directors today declared a quarterly dividend of $0.2150 per share. The dividend is payable to shareholders of record as of the close of business on Oct. 15, 2026, and will be paid on November 5, 2026.
